title: Module 1: Centroids, Distributed Loads, and Moments of Inertia
description: Compute centroids of composite shapes, replace distributed loads with equivalent point loads, and find area moments of inertia using the parallel-axis theorem and composite-bodies method. Bridge to mass moment of inertia for dynamics.
learning_objectives: Locate the centroid of a composite area using the area-weighted average (with negative areas for cutouts).
Replace a distributed load along a beam with an equivalent point load at the load's centroid.
Compute area moments of inertia for composite shapes using the parallel-axis theorem.
Distinguish area moment of inertia (m⁴, statics bending) from mass moment of inertia (kg·m², dynamics rotation).
